mechanism: iRSI(14, PRICE_CLOSE) buffer: detect RSI low when rsi[i+1]<30 and rsi[i]>rsi[i+1], RSI high when rsi[i+1]>70 and rsi[i]<rsi[i+1]. Map to MathMin/MathMax of the two corresponding candle lows/highs as liquidity levels. Trade when price sweeps below/above that level within last 3 bars then closes back through with matching candle color (bullish reclaim of swept low / bearish fail of swept high). 12-bar lock via Bars() so levels do not thrash while RSI stays extreme.

mechanism: Find two swing lows (IsSwingLow lookback) with later low higher → ascending OBJ_TREND; two swing highs with later high lower → descending. ObjectGetValueByTime samples line price at last 4 bar times. Reversal: wick pierces line while open stays on trend side, then bullish/bearish close reclaims within 3 bars, with prev_touch anti-repeat. Breakout-retest: after close through line, wick retests from opposite side and confirming close continues breakout direction.
data_needed: 500-bar OHLC; LookbackBars; ObjectGetValueByTime per recent bar; lastTradeBarTime

mechanism: Five swing points with Fibonacci extension gates: wave3 in Fib ext of 1–2; wave5 in Fib ext of 3–4; waves 3–4 at least ~70% of 1–2. Trendlines 1–3 and 2–4 frame structure; line 1–4 projects EPA/target. Sense completion when price breaks then reclaims the 1–3 line at wave5, with SL at wave5 extreme and TP at touch of 1–4 projection.

mechanism: At session open (e.g. 9:30 server), wait for first M15 bar close (9:45); freeze that bar's high/low as opening range. On M5, buy when m5_close[0] > m15_high and m5_close[1] < m15_high and candle bullish; sell when close crosses below m15_low with bearish body. Optional isBreakout latch for first breakout only; session close flat.

mechanism: Read user-drawn rectangle via ObjectGetDouble/Integer for price/time anchors → res_max/min and start/end. Inside zone time window, detect swing sequence HH→HL→H→L then close break below HL (bearish ChoCH) for resistance, or LL→LH→L→H then close break above LH (bullish ChoCH) for support. Require max high in window still inside rectangle (zone not violated). Trade on ChoCH bar with SL at ChoCH extreme.
